subject: Private VPC pricing discovery: token volumes, licensing & support
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Private VPC pricing discovery - token volumes & licensing

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning — good to meet you and Mike. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can put together a tailored pricing + deployment proposal: 

Summary of what I heard from the call:
- Goal: move core inference workloads for customer-facing product to a Private/VPC deployment (latency and data residency).
- Workloads: mix of chat-style generation and batch embedding jobs.
- Environments: prod + staging + dev (tentative, please confirm).

Follow-ups needed from you so we can size/license correctly:
1) Monthly token volumes (estimate ranges are fine: low/typical/peak month).
2) Target unit economics or budget range for inference (you mentioned you were aligning on a target $/1M tokens — helpful if you can share the target range).
3) Number of environments (prod/staging/dev) and whether you need separate clusters per region.
4) Desired support level (standard business hours vs. premium 24/7 + phone).

Attached is a short pricing options PDF that sketches the two common patterns we see for Private/VPC customers: 1) annual platform license + per-environment addon, 2) fully-managed dedicated with a consumption layer for overflow. It includes ballpark unit comparisons so you can see tradeoffs.

If you can send the three numbers above (volumes / budget / env & support), I’ll put together a concrete three-option quote (minimal, recommended, and performance) and we can schedule a technical sizing call with Marissa and our solutions engineer.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@fintechco.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing discovery - token volumes & licensing

Ben, thanks for the recap — that matches our notes. Answers below: 

1) Token volumes (monthly):
- Low month: ~45M tokens
- Typical month: ~120M tokens
- Peak month: up to ~320M tokens (around product launches)

2) Target unit economics / budget:
- We are trying to target ~$900 - $1,200 per 1M tokens (this is a combined internal target for inference spend across infra + licensing).
- Annual inference budget we can commit to right now is in the $180k - $300k range, depending on SLA and support.

3) Environments: 3 (prod, staging, dev). We expect staging to be a close replica of prod for rollout testing; dev can be smaller. No multi-region requirement at launch — US-only.

4) Support: We want premium (24/7) for prod. Staging/dev can be standard.

Let me know if you want any more telemetry details (qps, avg seq len). I can loop in our infra lead (Mike) for the technical sizing call.

—Alice
Alice Chen
Head of AI Platform | FintechCo
alice.chen@fintechco.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@fintechco.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing discovery - token volumes & licensing

Thanks Alice — that is really helpful. Based on those ranges I can outline three commercial options we typically propose for Private/VPC customers. These are ballpark figures; I will produce a spreadsheet with line-item detail once you confirm which option to pursue.

Option A — Minimal (self-host licence + basic support)
- Annual platform license: $95,000/yr
- Per-environment add-on: $12,500/env/yr (prod+staging+dev = $37,500)
- Support: Standard (business hours) included with license
- Notes: Suitable if you want maximum cost predictability and are comfortable with in-house ops. No per-token fee for private deployments.

Option B — Recommended (private deployment + managed ops bundle)
- Annual platform license: $120,000/yr
- Per-environment: $20,000/env/yr (3 envs = $60,000)
- Managed ops + premium support (24/7): 20% of license & env fees (~$36,000/yr)
- Optional overflow: hybrid managed-hosted token billing at $850 per 1M tokens for burst/overflow to hosted capacity
- Estimated total: ~$216,000/yr + overflow usage if needed

Option C — Performance (SLA-backed, dedicated capacity)
- Annual platform license: $180,000/yr
- Per-environment: $30,000/env/yr (3 envs = $90,000)
- Premium support & SRE: 25% uplift (~$67,500/yr)
- Dedicated reserved capacity (optional): priced based on GPU sizing; we can provide a sizing quote in the next call
- Estimated total: ~$337,500/yr + reserved capacity costs

Unit economics notes:
- For fully private (on-prem/VPC) deployments there is typically no per-token hosted charge — cost is driven by license + infra + support.
- We provide an optional hybrid overflow model where peak traffic spills to our managed hosted endpoints at a unit rate (we typically propose ~$850 / 1M tokens for overflow).
- Given your target $900–$1,200 / 1M tokens, Option B fits well if you expect moderate overflow. Option A could work if you can absorb ops internally and keep infra efficient.

Next steps:
- Do you want a detailed line-item spreadsheet for Option A/B/C? I can include an illustrative infra sizing (GPU count, memory, disk), expected peak qps, and a forecasted monthly cost curve.
- I recommend a technical sizing call with Marissa (solutions engineer) and Mike to confirm GPU sizing and latency SLOs. Available times tomorrow 10–12 PT or Wed 1–4 PT.

I attached a short spreadsheet with the above high-level numbers — will follow up with a more granular version if you want to proceed.

Best,
Ben

Attachments: Private-VPC-pricing-breakdown.xlsx

Hi all — quick technical note before the sizing call:

- For the typical profile Alice shared (120M typical / 320M peak) we usually size prod at 4-6 A100-class GPUs with CPU headroom for batching and a smaller staging cluster at ~1-2 GPUs. Dev can be a single smaller node.
- If you want sub-200ms p95 generation latency we’ll need to pick model variants and quantization profile carefully; I’ll bring our model-ops playbook to the call.
- Compliance: we support customer-managed KMS/HSM and audit log exports; if FintechCo needs SOC2 artifacts I’ll include the evidence checklist in the follow-up doc.

I’m free tomorrow 10:30–11:30 PT for a 30–45m sizing session. Ben — can you drop an invite?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

See you on the call.

—Alice
